customer_asks.ask: Richmond only; neuropathy first; readable typography; real supplied identity; no fake providers or proof.
Preserve selected Forward Standard B language without new creative exploration.

hard_rules: Use the supplied Sigma Core logo and wordmark as-is. Never redesign, recolor, re-letter, regenerate, restyle, or reinterpret it; design references use plain type or a neutral reserved logo area.
Richmond, Virginia is the only market. Exclude Fort Lauderdale and every Florida reference.
Never claim Sigma Core cures or reverses any disease or condition, guarantees outcomes, restores youth, eliminates pain, avoids surgery, or provides a named treatment that has not been verified.

Keep service information concise, benefit-led, non-diagnostic, and at category level. Do not publish treatment protocols, mechanisms, prices, candidacy, timelines, medications, tests, devices, or unverified modalities.
Do not identify Dr. Jason Hurst as a treating provider or show him in a public clinical team structure.

Do not invent Medical Director or Nurse Practitioner names, photos, biographies, credentials, testimonials, ratings, awards, certifications, badges, statistics, patient outcomes, insurance details, appointment duration, availability, phone, email, or hours.

Do not render empty provider cards, fake team portraits, fake testimonial cards, star ratings, before-and-after imagery, or unsupported trust signals. Team and testimonial components may be modular in code but remain absent publicly until approved real content exists. Any future testimonial must visibly state 'Results not typical'.
Stock or AI-generated clinicians must never be shown as Sigma Core staff. Generic people must never be labeled as patients, providers, named individuals, or result examples.
General marketing forms collect no free-text medical history, symptoms, diagnosis, or other PHI. Any PHI workflow requires an appropriate HIPAA agreement and safeguards.
Do not load standard advertising or analytics trackers on authenticated or condition-specific patient flows without compliance review.
The educational guide must not appear available until the customer supplies the approved resource title, media, delivery method, consent language, and GoHighLevel details.

No generic hospital-blue template, sterile all-white system, purple-to-blue SaaS gradient, glassmorphism, decorative medical dashboard, DNA helix, molecule, lotus, glowing nerve, anatomical fear image, autoplay video, intrusive popup, fake scarcity, or tiny low-contrast silver copy.

Do not use visible 01/02/03 sequence numbers, chapter numbers, folio numbers, oversized ghost numerals, or numbered editorial markers. Communicate sequence with language, spatial progression, material transitions, or unnumbered wayfinding.
Primary body copy is at least 18px in the coded site, controls are at least 48px, contrast is WCAG AA or better, and reduced-motion preferences are honored.
Every visually control-shaped element has the useful outcome defined in its section interaction_contract. State labels, steps, and principles are static content, not inert controls.
Frames cover content sections only. Global navigation and footer belong to the built design system and must never be rendered into interior-page frames.
No visible decorative numbers, chapter numbers, folio markers, index numerals, or ghost numerals. Factual dates and address numbers are allowed.
No 3D/sculptural Material Current imagery, portals, metallic ribbons, liquid chrome, fantasy architecture, product-render slabs, glowing energy streams, or abstract caves.

No public street address, opening date, availability, experience, patient-volume or clinical/proof claims. Keep all status content tied to the pinned repository, not presumed current business operation.
All six candidate native frames are 1536x864 as requested. They are raster design references, never runtime section assets. No global navigation or footer is drawn.

Retain /about and all existing anchors: hero, clinic-purpose, our-mission, facility-gallery, care-principles, team-publication-gate, booking-cta. The existing Contact location-status fragment is absent; use verified-location-details for the candidate action.
Candidate only; no implementation, canonical promotion, raster retirement, registry/section-fidelity edits, noindex changes or approval is authorized by this package.
R1 is an offline code-rendered provisional source/copy/decomposition investigation. No r1 pixel geometry or offline frame is used as an API reference or canonical image-model output.
